personality_one_liner: Command center precision meets civic trust with clean typography, warm stone surfaces, and confident data hierarchies.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, consistent margins, and clean touch targets >= 44pt for field volunteers.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and floating bottom sheets
Apply translucent surface tint over cards and chart overlays
dont's: Never blur body text or form inputs
Do not use heavy dark blurs that obscure underlying navigation

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure authentication for campaign administrators and field collaborators with role-based entry.

states.loading: Centered botanical spinner with subtle brand pulse
states.empty: Clean credential entry form with clear validation cues
states.error: Inline banner with readable error message and retry action

screens.layout: Centered clean authentication card with role selector toggle (Administrador / Colaborador), credential inputs, and instant biometric or email login.

screens.name: CampaignHome
screens.purpose: Central command dashboard displaying live vote totals, progress towards target, and scenario probability modeling.

states.loading: Full skeleton card placeholders for metric widgets and chart blocks
states.empty: Prompt to create a campaign and set initial voter targets
states.error: Error banner with refresh button and offline cache notice

screens.layout: Top sticky campaign selector header, primary progress ring card with scenario toggles (Ruim / Real / Otimista), quick metric cards grid, and recent field update feed.

screens.name: CampaignForm
screens.purpose: General campaign management form allowing admins and collaborators to update targets, registered votes, and estimate projections.

states.loading: Input skeleton rows with shimmering surface dividers
states.empty: Pre-populated campaign parameters ready for editing
states.error: Validation warning highlights on out-of-range numeric fields

screens.layout: Scrollable form with sticky bottom action bar, grouped numeric stepper inputs for Meta de Votos, Votos Contabilizados, and Votos Estimados, plus scenario formula modifiers.

screens.name: TeamPermissions
screens.purpose: Manage campaign team members, assigning Admin and Colaborador roles with distinct access rights.

states.loading: List skeleton rows with circular avatar placeholders
states.empty: Empty team state with prominent invite collaborator CTA
states.error: Permission sync error message with retry trigger

screens.layout: List of team collaborators with role badges, permission toggle sheets, and an invite collaborator modal.

hero_banner.alt: Political campaign data and analytics dashboard preview

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a high-performance React Native app in Expo for political campaign vote tracking and probability projection (Ruim, Real, Otimista). Ensure role-based access for Admin and Colaborators, interactive scenario calculations, and a gorgeous dashboard with charts and progress rings. Strictly adhere to iOS-Native Clean personality, warm botanical tones (forest green & cream), touch targets >= 44pt, and zero banned colors.
